FactionItem.GetDiscontent.semantic: reads FactionItem+0x00 full faction ID, resolves storage and generation, reads CFaction+0x28 fixed discontent, writes stock Q100000 final getter value

FactionItem.GetPower.semantic: reads FactionItem+0x00 full faction ID, resolves storage and generation, calls target-minus-member strength and member strength leaves, writes stock Q100000 ratio

direct_targeting_source.semantic: stock FactionsWindow refresh copies each full-generation faction ID from the player's land-state vector to an inline FactionItem without filtering; this read-only source is independent of the UI row getter

publication: resolve CFaction from the full ID and exact vtable before calling either getter; reject getter fallback; accept only paired stable identity, underlying discontent and final values on the same paused application-main frame
